html:
SMTO-GML-0016 — The email has no message text

GUID: 3e6ba2e3-0a4a-4531-8a36-f9f5351b2216
Slug: gmail-message-body-required
Domain: GML · Subsystem: gml

What happened

  • SMTO was asked to write or send an email, but the email had no text in it. SMTO stopped before creating a draft or sending anything.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO again and include the message you want to send, for example "Reply saying I can meet on Tuesday at 3 pm". SMTO needs some actual text for the body of the email.
  2. When SMTO shows the email for approval, check that the message text is there before you select Approve once. This confirms the email isn't blank before it goes out.
  3. If you meant to send only an attachment, ask SMTO to add a short line of text, such as "Please see the attached file." SMTO won't send an email with an empty body, even with an attachment.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows an email with text in it and, after you approve, reports it as created or sent.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep asking for the same email without saying what it should contain.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Gmail compose/reply preparation produced neither a plain-text nor an HTML body (body_text, body and body_html all empty), so no message was built.

What this means

  • Message preparation has neither plain-text nor HTML body content after applying compose/reply/forward options. Gmail provider receipts and exact account/message identities determine effects. Authorization, pagination or presentation failure cannot undo a send or other mutation; diagnostic rendering performs no mailbox or OAuth request.

Why this can happen

  • Message preparation has neither plain-text nor HTML body content after applying compose/reply/forward options.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the actual body/body_html and selected operation rather than the subject alone.

How to fix it

  • GmailService.mime raises gmail_message_body_required when payload.body_text/body and body_html are all empty for compose or reply. Supply non-empty body_text (or body_html) in the gmail.send/create__draft payload.
  • Supply a non-empty supported message body.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • A deliberate nonempty supported message body validates before send.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Gmail provider receipts and exact account/message identities determine effects. Authorization, pagination or presentation failure cannot undo a send or other mutation; diagnostic rendering performs no mailbox or OAuth request.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
